title: imap: FETCH command handler (FLAGS, UID, RFC822.SIZE, BODY[], ENVELOPE)
description: Create crates/imap/src/commands/fetch.rs. FETCH takes a sequence set and attribute list. Algorithm: (1) require Selected state; (2) resolve sequence set to article numbers via ArticleNumberStore::group_range(); (3) for each article number: (a) lookup CID via ArticleNumberStore::lookup_cid(); (b) for FLAGS: query imap_flags table for this (user, group, cid); (c) for UID: assign sequential uid from imap_uid_map table; (d) for RFC822.SIZE: use OverviewStore::query_range() to get byte_count; (e) for INTERNALDATE: parse OverviewRecord.date into RFC 3501 date format; (f) for ENVELOPE: build Envelope struct from OverviewRecord fields; (g) for BODY[]: fetch raw bytes from IpfsBlockStore::get_raw_block(cid), decode DAG-CBOR article, extract wire-format bytes; (4) send * N FETCH for each message; (5) tagged OK. Defensive: article not found -> skip; IPFS unavailable -> tagged NO.
